text:
incident-bot: PagerDuty notification triggered -> auto-page to oncall-sre (PD: C-ops-edge). Symptom: ~20% of API requests returning 502/504 from apac-edge regions, spike in TLS handshake timeouts. Rolling alarm: edge-lb-health-check-failures.
pagerduty-bot: Incident created: PD-INC-48291. Priority: P2. Timestamps and links: https://pagerduty.local/incidents/PD-INC-48291
oncall-sre: Acked in PD, joining. Initial triage: seeing target group health check flaps on the apac-targets pool. TL;DR: backend instances healthy, but ALB reports failing TLS handshake from several edge proxies.
netops-jamie: I can confirm DNS for edge-apac.redwood.ai recently had a TTL change 12:30 UTC (shortened to 60s). Could be propagation noise + new frontdoor config. Pulling recent deploys.
eng-platform-maya: Rolling deploy to edge-proxy service finished 12:25 UTC (hash: a1b2c3). Release notes: change to connection reuse for TLS sessions. Reverting to previous build is possible.
oncall-sre: Quick check: curl from eu and us to apac-edge shows intermittent handshake failures. From eu: `curl -Iv https://edge-apac.redwood.ai --connect-timeout 3` yields several `SSL handshake failure` lines.
netops-jamie: Showing spike in SYN+TLS retransmits at the edge LB panels. Also seeing increased latency to origin for SNI-based routing on some nodes. Could be mismatch in hostname routing after deploy.
eng-platform-maya: Not seeing errors in app logs – backends accepted connections fine. This smells like proxy -> LB config mismatch or a cert/cipher negotiation regression. I’ll re-run canary traffic to replicate.
oncall-sre: Customer impact estimate: approx 7% of requests failing for a subset of APAC customers; some sign-in flows hit the failing nodes. Marking customer visible.
cust-success-ali: We already have two support tickets about slow logins from APAC. Customers flagged are on APAC region. I'll start templated outreach if we need a wider communication.
pagerduty-bot: Escalation timer at 8m -> will escalate if no remediation.
netops-jamie: Looking at ALB health check log: most failing checks show `alert: TLS handshake error: no shared cipher`. Example log snippet: ```time=12:32:11 host=alb-apac-09 check=health path=/hc code=0 err="no shared cipher"```
eng-platform-maya: Wait — we recently enabled a new cipher preference list on the proxy (BoringSSL flag tweak) to prefer x25519. Some older edge LB instances might not accept that ordering. Rolling back the flag on proxies now.
oncall-sre: While Maya rolls back, can we put the affected ALB targets to draining and let healthy nodes handle traffic? netops, do we have a safe weight-shift?
netops-jamie: Yes. I can shift weights away from the suspect AZ for the next 10m to stabilize. Doing a 50->0 weight ramp on targets in apac-az3 now. Command: `aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:... --attributes ...` (executed).
eng-platform-maya: Rollback triggered: reverted cipher list on proxy canary hosts (3 nodes). Monitoring logs.```

noncall-sre: Observability check: TLS handshake failure rate dropped from 18% to 3% in the past 4 minutes after weight shift + rollback. Latency for successful connections is back to baseline.
netops-jamie: DNS note: because TTL was low, some clients re-resolved and hit old edge nodes. I've pushed a temporary negative cache tweak at the authoritative DNS to prefer healthy edge prefix via traffic steering (will hold for 5m).
eng-platform-maya: Confirmed no new handshake errors on canary. Rolling rollback to all nodes in apac-edge (30 nodes) with 10s pause between batches.
cust-success-ali: Preparing update for affected customers: short note that APAC sign-in degradation observed and we rolled configuration; follow-up with root cause after postmortem.
pagerduty-bot: Auto-escalation canceled (incident acknowledged and mitigation in progress).
incident-bot: Annotated: mitigation actions: cipher rollback, LB weight shift, DNS traffic steering. Postmortem owner: eng-platform-maya. Estimated SLA impact: <0.5% error budget for APAC for the hour window.
oncall-sre: Requesting post-rollback verification: please run full smoke across APAC regions (auth, generate, embed). I'll keep watching health-check stream.
eng-platform-maya: Starting smoke: `pytest tests/smoke/test_edge_endpoints.py::test_smoke_apac -k smoke -q` -> first pass looks clean.
netops-jamie: LB health checks steady at 99.9% now. No more `no shared cipher` logs. Reverting temporary DNS steering in 5m.
cust-success-ali: Sending interim note to impacted customers now. Template: "We've mitigated an APAC edge connectivity issue caused by a recent proxy cipher setting change. Services restored; follow-up with root cause and preventative actions to come."
oncall-sre: Marking incident as mitigated. Will keep thread open for follow-up and postmortem. If errors reappear we re-open. :white_check_mark:
